system.description:
The dangerous opposite of Null: an illegal, highly addictive drug that forces the mind open to the Warp.

For one scene the user gains +1k1 on every spellcasting roll and +1 caster level. Taking a dose, and every spell cast while it lasts, automatically produces a warp phenomenon.
system.effectText: +1k1 spellcasting and +1 caster level for a scene; dosing and each spell trigger warp phenomena.
